svg.title: FID versus CLIPScore
svg.desc: FID compares feature distributions of real and generated image sets; CLIPScore is the cosine similarity of a generated image and its prompt, 0.82 on-prompt versus 0.24 off-prompt.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Two separate questions: realistic? (FID) and on-prompt? (CLIPScore)

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
